title: Flocking Boids
description: Separation, alignment, and cohesion are the only three rules. The shape of the flock follows from them. Ten presets, 2D and 3D, with predators, obstacles, and currents you can paint into the sky.

title: Predator and Prey
description: Every dot is one animal with its own energy budget, grazing, hunting, and breeding. The boom and bust population cycles come out of those individual decisions.

title: Pendulum Chaos
description: Release a hundred pendulums that differ by a tenth of a degree and watch them tear apart. Deterministic and predictable turn out to be two different things.

title: N-Body Gravity
description: Newton's one rule, applied to everything at once. Build a star system, run the figure-eight, watch three bodies go chaotic, park a probe at a Lagrange point, or collide two galaxies.

title: Lens & Image Formation
description: An optical bench with real ray tracing. Move the object, the lens, and the sensor, and watch the image form. Aperture, focus error, blur circles, and spherical aberration, with a live view of what the sensor actually records.

title: Epidemic Spread (SIR)
description: Susceptible, infected, and recovered agents wander and mix. Change the infection rate and the recovery time to make an outbreak burn out or take off.

title: Traffic Jams
description: One lane of road bent into a circle, where nothing can hold a car up except the car in front. Every driver follows the Intelligent Driver Model. Tap the brakes on one car and watch the wave outlive it, or pack the road until an ordinary wobble on the pedal is enough to stop it. Live space-time diagram, and self-driving cars to try to fix it.
hook: A brake tap becomes a wave

title: Lorenz Attractor
description: A shallow layer of fluid heated from below, which is a pan before it boils or the inside of a growing cloud, stripped to the three numbers it cannot do without. Turn the heating past 24.7 and a layer that used to settle never settles again. Rotate the attractor, and release a swarm of near identical starts to watch them come apart.

title: Turing's Morphogenesis
description: Two chemicals react and spread through a sheet of tissue that starts perfectly even, and spots, stripes, and labyrinths appear with no blueprint anywhere. Twelve presets on a live map of the chemistry, a growing field that inserts new stripes as it stretches, and diffusion you can point along one axis.

title: Hodgkin-Huxley Axon
description: The 1952 squid axon equations, running live.

title: The Shape of Chance
tags: type I and type II errors
description: Five machines built from raw randomness: a Galton board you can drag apart, sampling from height, wealth and asteroid sizes, confidence intervals you can audit, a screening test where the two ways of being wrong trade against each other, and darts that measure pi.

title: Schelling's Segregation Model
description: Mild individual preferences about who lives next door are enough to segregate a whole city. A classic result in social science.

title: Conway's Game of Life
description: One rule about live and dead neighbours is enough to produce gliders, oscillators, and patterns that never settle down.

title: Pharmacokinetics
description: How the concentration of a drug in the body rises and falls over time, and what different dosing schedules do to that curve.
